- **Where it came from:** Ilse posted it in #north-random on 10/13, and Dana is a member there. Ilse also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom. I passed that on too.
- **What I couldn't check:** I didn't find any later status update on the ticket. #help-it-ops is empty.
- **What I left out:** Dana's private guess about a future ticket number (OPS-5546) stayed out of the channel. It came from their DM with me, and they asked me to keep it private.
